translation: Come on, everyone—hurry!
You too, little sister. Come on!
Coming!

Haruhi led the way, gushing with motivation
that'll only cause trouble for the rest of us.
Well, that's just the way it always is.

Even so, ghost stories in midsummer is such a
cliché it makes me want to cry.

Well, if we just go along with Haruhi, she'll be
satisfied and—
No, she's not that straightforward…
I just saw something outside the window…
Really? What was it?

It wasn't a bird or anything. It was definitely
human-sized.

…Human-sized? That's ridiculous, there's no
way that could—
Whoa…?!
H-huh? Kyon, what's going on?
I-I'm just seeing things, right…?
Is something wrong, Kyon?
…Nothing, just my imagination.
I get it. It's all just an optical illusion.

My brain secreted a strange substance
after hearing Haruhi's ghost story.
I'm sure that's all it is.

I've figured out the scientific explanation, so
let's go, Asahina.

Haruhi will get mad if we just sit here
absentmindedly.
That's right…

…I'm not sure what's going on, but she
certainly gets mad when we're late.
Asahina had a curious look on her face.

The moment she heard Haruhi's name, she
gave a pained smile and agreed.
Alright, let's quickly catch up—
Huh…?!
What's happening? I'm dizzy all of a sudden…
Huh…

It's not too often in life that you doubt your
own eyes.

And yet, I've now experienced it twice in just a
few minutes.

…Actually, now isn't the time for detached
commentary.
Is this… the main building?

Just a moment ago, I was in the hallway
leading from the clubroom to the main building.

But in an instant, I had entered the
first-year hallway.

And what's more, Asahina, who had been by my
side, was gone.
No, maybe it was me who had disappeared?

Teleportation? Something else? Why did this
happen?
…I have no idea.

Generally, this sort of thing should be left to
Koizumi.

I'll just head back to the clubroom building for
now.
…Wait wait wait wait!

There's definitely something strange going on
here!

No matter how far I walk, the hallway never
ends. I don't believe it!

I already had a feeling, but this really
doesn't seem to be any ordinary place.
Oh, right, I'll open the window and go outside…
Damn, it won't even budge?
…What should I do?

If I keep walking, I'm only going to waste my
energy.
So much for my long-awaited summer vacation.

Why do I have to feel like a hamster spinning
in a wheel?

Why would anyone want to trap me here
anyway?
Not to mention, in such a convoluted way.
No… wait.

I don't know the reason or purpose, but there
is always only one "cause.”
Haruhi Suzumiya.
If that's the case, then maybe…
I saw the classroom door by my side… and…

Why do the things we don't want to see show
up so vividly like this?
There it was, the thing we—

No, the thing Haruhi's looking for—the door
to that "class 1-10” towered before me.
And, politely, it was ever so slightly ajar.
What…? Are you… trying to tell me to come in?

I would never open such a blatantly
suspicious door under normal circumstances.
However…

The hallway goes on forever and the windows
are stuck as if time has stopped.
This door is my last hope…
Should I try opening it?
Is that the only choice I have…?

In a situation like this, that's probably just
the way it is…

When I reached out and put light pressure on
the class 1-10 door, it moved easily.
Ah, is that how it is?
Seems like this is the only place I can go.

Hey Haruhi. This classroom doesn't actually
eat people, right?
…What is this place?

I thought I'd entered the classroom, but it
was a room without windows or anything.

Wait a second… I've been through this
before…

When I turned around, the door I came
through was gone.

It's just like when I was almost killed in a
classroom before.

But the only thing they have in common is that
I don't see a way out.

So far there doesn't seem to be anything
life-threatening.

Instead of a woman with a knife in the room,
there was just a single laptop.

What? Am I supposed to write an auto-biogr-
aphy or a novel? Or is this for communication?

At any rate, the only things I saw were a
desk, a chair, and the laptop.

After some hesitation, I reached for the
laptop.
Right then…
Don't touch that.
Huh?!

From behind me came the usual emotionless
voice.

But for now it was as if the goddess of
salvation had descended.
Nagato…!
Stay away.

She means from the computer, right? Is it
really that dangerous?

Nagato, what the hell is going on? Is this
Haruhi's doing?
Actually, more importantly…

Where the hell is this place? I thought I was
entering a classroom.
You did.

But obviously something strange is going on
here.
This place is out of phase with normal space.
A parallel world?

Not precisely, but there is no problem with you
conceptualizing it that way.

Anyway, I've had enough of this gloomy place.
Any chance we can go back?

The connection with the original space is not
yet completely severed.
But it's only a matter of time.
I don't understand at all.

Well, we can escape from this infinite hell
though, right?
It's possible.

Well, you can go ahead and get it over and
done with then.
It is not recommended.
What's the problem?

We can escape from this space, but we should
not leave it be.

This space is expanding and will soon
encompass the entire school.
Or even further than that.

If that happens, the original space will be
eroded and transformed.
You mean the original world become like this?

I don't understand the details, but it'll be a
big nuisance to the neighborhood, right?
Yes.

In that case, shouldn't we just destroy this
messed-up space?
Forcibly eliminating or erasing this space…
…may have an impact on the original space.
An impact? What kind?

Details are unknown. However, the extent and
degree of the impact can be inferred.
Wait… Just wait a second, Nagato.

I wish Koizumi were here to translate this into
something easier to understand.

But he isn't here now, so this explanation
makes no sense to me.

So, in the end, what's your recommended way
of dealing with this?
Make this space naturally dissolve.

In order to make the space naturally
dissolve…

…it is necessary to erase the "singularities”
that serve as the space's structural cores.
You can do that, right?
Currently impossible.

Right now, I am focusing on suppressing its
expansion and analyzing its cause.

Your cooperation is required in order to bring
about natural dissolution.

Sounds like it's pretty serious then, huh…
Alright, what do you want me to do?
[#DP]

Having heard my words, Nagato turned and
headed to the edge of the former classroom.
You want me to follow you, right?

Nagato stopped in front of the cleaning
supplies locker.

She picked up a mop and muttered something
quickly.
Sweep with this.

I took the mop she handed me without
complaining, but…
Where?
Where you are standing.

I guess if you're gonna sweep anything with a
mop, it'd probably be the floor.

This isn't just any mop, though.
It's been specially modified by Nagato.

Besides, what else was I going to do? I've
just got to do as Nagato says.

[#P04Would] you like to play the tutorial for the
puzzle phase?

And so, I erased the singularity or whatever
while Nagato lectured me.

However, once I'd erased a few of the
singularities, something abnormal happened.

I felt like my body was being forcefully pulled
somewhere.

The very next moment, I was back in the
original hallway.

[#P04Now] starting the tutorial for the Puzzle
Phase.
Skip tutorial
Play tutorial
